claim: A price change on an approved order re-runs the approval rules for the person making it, and one their rules do not cover waits for a signature (ADR 0244 D3 amendment; founder 2026-09-30, verbatim picks F1 Pending price change (Recommended), F2 Yes, gate it (Recommended), F3 Yes, wait (Recommended), F4 Any price change). (1) PATCH /procurement/orders/:id on an APPROVED, CONFIRMED or IN_TRANSIT order: any move of quoted/negotiated/final price or total_cost, down included, re-runs every rule for the editor through priceRecheck (decideApproval + roleSatisfies, the approve act's own rule; unwired or unreadable rules refuse with a 500). Not covered: no figure is written, the change is a waiting row of procurement_order_price_changes (migration a_price_change_waits_for_a_signature: RLS on, service_role only, one waiting per order, actor keys on public.users), 202 with pendingPriceChange, order_price_change_waiting filed, approvers told on the bell; notes in the same edit still apply. (2) The sealed act: POST orders/:id/price-change-seal-challenge and POST orders/:id/price-change/approve (act approve_price_change, seal over the change id, source, figures and replayed terms), GET orders/:id/price-change; the approver's rules re-run before any seal, a stale change (a touched figure moved, or the order left the state its act lands in) is refused 409 and closed, the row is claimed conditionally and un-claimed on failure. (3) confirm-deal runs the rules for the confirmer (owners and managers included, superseding that part of ADR 0175, bracketed there) before its seal is spent; over them the exact terms are held as a confirm_deal change, nothing committed or mailed; approval confirms through the one commit (commitConfirmedDeal); dismissing the deal closes it. (4) The POST orders dedup merge into an APPROVED order is re-checked for the requester AFTER #538's D2 role gate (staff are refused, never held) and held as an order_merge change that replays into that order only. (5) The inbound responder's autonomy accept approves only when no rule fires and none is untestable (rules via ModuleRef; absent or unreadable fails closed); otherwise the order stays in negotiation and the offer waits on its deal proposal; the vendor's word no longer rewrites an APPROVED order's negotiated price over the rules (declines exempt); its order read now selects restaurant_id, so the decline notice reaches the house. Builder's readings filed as open questions in the ADR: the effective total max(total_cost, unit price x quantity), price_verified is not a price, the autonomy is not within an untestable rule, post-delivery edits unchanged. NOT this claim: no web surface shows or approves a held change yet (follow-up). Behaviour: order-price-recheck.spec.ts and inbound-responder.service.spec.ts (35 REVERT-FAILS cases, all red on e9c6ffe89, #538's head), 22 of 22 service/controller/responder mutations killed; PGlite full-corpus build with a no-migration control. This verify: 31 reasons on e9c6ffe89, and 23 of 23 tripwire mutations (index, CHECK, states, effective total, each gate, the held write, fail-closed, the merge and its place after the D2 role gate, the act, the conditional claim, the change id, a route, the 202, the autonomy's rules and untestable, the house read, a gate left only in a comment, both ADRs) each reported, 2026-09-30.
